item.title: Are Stoics Emotionless? The Truth About Suppressing Your Feelings
item.description: No, Stoics are not emotionless robots. If you are wondering whether adopting this ancient philosophy means you have to stop feeling joy, sadness, or love, the answer is a resounding no.
